title_zh: 可迁移自动驾驶机制比较表
author: 许丙南
boundary_note: The six cases below are paraphrased from the listed official public pages and used only to compare mechanisms. They do not assert a partnership, local performance, legal equivalence or implementation commitment for Jing-Zhang.

cases.name: Beijing automated-vehicle road-test and demonstration rules
cases.mechanism: L3+ tests and demonstrations operate through a joint municipal mechanism and only within approved areas and roads.
cases.jingzhang_transfer: Treat the approved road or bounded site, accountable subject, test window and stop authority as release-blocking fields.
cases.do_not_copy: The Beijing pathway does not designate any Jing-Zhang road, operator, vehicle or permit.

cases.name: CETRAN AV Test Centre and public-path test-before-exemption
cases.mechanism: A dedicated test centre reproduces road conditions; public paths remain restricted and require testing before an exemption can be considered.
cases.jingzhang_transfer: Complete closed-site and shared-path checks before proposing any public-route window, with pedestrians and active-mobility users as explicit reviewers.
cases.do_not_copy: Passing a foreign test framework is not a Beijing exemption, certification or local safety result.

cases.name: UK automated-vehicle trialling code of practice
cases.mechanism: Trial organisers retain responsibility, engage affected authorities and the public, prepare a safety case and publish an abridged public version.
cases.jingzhang_transfer: Require a public safety note, named takeover role, insurance and engagement record before a bounded trial window opens.
cases.do_not_copy: UK legal conditions and safety-driver rules do not create Chinese permission or immunity from liability.

cases.name: Transport for London guidance for CAV trials
cases.mechanism: Local trial review is tied to existing transport duties and the priority of walking, cycling and public transport.
cases.jingzhang_transfer: Make ordinary walking, wheelchair, cycling and rail-transfer continuity a precondition, not a mitigation added after the vehicle route.
cases.do_not_copy: London policy is not a Beijing rule, and policy alignment does not prove a local route is safe or available.

cases.name: Eiheiji Level 4 automated mobility authorisation
cases.mechanism: A specific vehicle and service received approval under a bounded operating design domain, with safe stopping when continuation becomes difficult.
cases.jingzhang_transfer: Write each candidate window as a bounded ODD and require a visible safe-stop and staffed recovery path for every exit condition.
cases.do_not_copy: A Japanese authorisation is not a transferable vehicle approval, service result, route or remote-operation permission.

cases.name: NHTSA AV TEST public tracking tool
cases.mechanism: A voluntary public map distinguishes testing locations, routes or zones, the technology developer, site coordinator and physical operator.
cases.jingzhang_transfer: Publish the bounded location, operating status, coordinator, operator and update date without implying the map is complete evidence of safety.
cases.do_not_copy: Voluntary disclosure is incomplete by design and does not replace incident reporting, regulation, consent or independent review.

rows.borrow: Treat a station approach as a civic room with rest, wayfinding, care and complaint access.
rows.do_not_copy: Do not copy a commercial branding or assume station ownership permits public programming.
rows.jingzhang_test: Four-quadrant pedestrian continuity and staffed status board at Dazhongsi.

rows.borrow: Use a short, booked test window with a named safety lead, a stop gate and a public post-test note.
rows.do_not_copy: Do not turn residents into unconsenting test subjects or retain individual trajectories.
rows.jingzhang_test: Low-speed delivery robot and red-team sandbox at Zhongzhi Garden.

rows.borrow: Make shade, infiltration, seating and maintenance work orders one visible public system.
rows.do_not_copy: Do not hide drainage capacity behind a sensor dashboard or decorative planting claim.
rows.jingzhang_test: Rainwater tree-pit unit with pre-storm and post-storm checks.

rows.borrow: Publish questions, contributions, model cards and decisions in a durable commons.
rows.do_not_copy: Do not use open-source language to bypass IP, procurement, security or community consent.
rows.jingzhang_test: Open publishing room and contribution wall at the AI Origin Community.

rows.borrow: Keep a low-glare, low-noise, step-free night route for carers, workers and older residents.
rows.do_not_copy: Do not equate more lighting, cameras or event density with safety.
rows.jingzhang_test: Quiet chain, audible/tactile wayfinding and human night patrol.

rows.borrow: Use engineering questions, repair traces and public contribution as a living cultural narrative.
rows.do_not_copy: Do not reproduce historical images, logos or quotations without explicit clearance.
rows.jingzhang_test: Engineering question wall, contribution archive and responsibility desk.
